method: Read-only pinned source/workflow and existing build metadata investigation; no full Runtime build or objdir archive download.

findings.fact: MacWebAppService.mm is a non-unified SOURCES entry in widget/cocoa/moz.build, uses -fobjc-arc, and belongs to xul.
The standalone floorp-app-shim program compiles 8 Shim translation units and does not compile the host service.

A compatible configured objdir can permit a single host translation-unit compilation; a full clean build is not inherently mandatory. Compatible SDK/compiler/flags and generated headers are necessary.
A changed native host object must be linked into xul and put into a new test package before host execution evidence is possible.
An existing precompiled browser or source-only artifact build cannot incorporate changed compiled native C++.
The pinned normal Mac workflow builds on Linux cross compilation with sccache enabled. No verified cache hit or ready configured objdir was established.
The archived outputs save dist rather than a complete configured objdir.

The existing recorder checks version and 12 pinned patched source files; the host service is outside that set. A future native build needs explicit patch/compiled-source provenance while retaining those checks.
Any later full native integration must apply the patch before configure/compile and retain PGO profiling/optimization and existing verification/publication gates.
